name: phil/terms-bundle
description: Versioned terms of use in Symfony: each version published once and never changed, each acceptance recorded, and members asked again when the terms change.

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the two tables to the schema the ORM generates, for doctrine:migrations:diff
suggest.easycorp/easyadmin-bundle: For the links of the administration in an EasyAdmin back office
suggest.phil/ip-anonymizer: To keep the network of the address an acceptance came from, never the address itself
suggest.phil/legal-notices-bundle: For phil:terms:check-legal-links, the check that the legal links exist on the site
suggest.phil/notifications-bundle: To tell the members that a new version awaits their acceptance, and to remind them
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: For the acceptance records in the export and the erasure of a person's data
suggest.phil/text-diff: For the changes between two versions on the public pages
suggest.phil/ujo: For policy texts written as UJO (Universal JSON Output) documents
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes the pages draw — Alert, Badge, Button, Checkbox, Field, Input, NativeSelect, Table, Textarea —, through the Symfony UX Toolkit; or the same recipes from the Shadcn kit of the Toolkit, on Tailwind
suggest.symfony/console: For phil:terms:outstanding, the list of the members who have not accepted
suggest.symfony/form: For the acceptance checkbox added to a signup form
suggest.symfony/scheduler: For the reminders sent on a schedule
suggest.symfony/translation: For the pages and the administration in English and French
